item.title: Austin City Council to vote on ordinance for loud vehicle engine noises
item.description: On Thursday, Austin City Council will vote on whether to amend the city code, so officers can cite for loud vehicle engine noise. The city has gotten a lot of complaints about excessive noise in residential areas, often from motorcycles and speeding cars. There is currently nothing in the law that allows officers to cite for loud engine noise.
